directive: 会話グラフ、分岐条件、前後の返答を読んで、日本語版ゲームの自然な台詞として執筆する。
translation_policy: F:\Games\Radiophobia 3\Translate\Radiophobia 3 会話グラフ翻訳方針.md

entries.EN: How's the situation down at the lab, you sent anyone in there yet?
entries.JA_current: How's the situation down at the lab, you sent anyone in there yet?
entries.JA_new: 研究所の様子はどうだ？ 誰か送り込んだのか？

entries.EN: Good thing you reminded me, Marked One! \nWe have a situation: we've lost all contact with the research team that went down there. \nWe sent Doctor Petrov and his assistant, along with a detachment of guards, to the X-16 laboratory right after the psi intensity dropped to zero. It was established that he would contact us here at the bunker immediately after entering the complex, but we have not heard from him since he departed and it is well past the scheduled entry time. I feel concerned for my colleague and his companions, as you know there are many dangers down there even with the psi-field switched off! Marked One, if it is not too difficult, could you go down into X-16 again and check up on them? You've already been there so you're the best man for the job.

It was established that he would contact us here at the bunker immediately after entering the complex, but we have not heard from him since he departed and it is well past the scheduled entry time. I feel concerned for my colleague and his companions, as you know there are many dangers down there even with the psi-field switched off! Marked One, if it is not too difficult, could you go down into X-16 again and check up on them? You've already been there so you're the best man for the job.
entries.JA_new: 思い出させてくれて助かったよ、マークド・ワン！ \n問題が起きてね。現地の研究班と連絡が取れなくなった。 \nサイ強度がゼロまで下がった直後、ペトロフ博士と助手、それに護衛部隊をX-16研究所へ向かわせたんだ。研究所に入ったらすぐ、ここの地下壕へ連絡する手はずだった。だが出発してから一度も連絡がなく、予定時刻をとっくに過ぎている。同僚や同行者たちが心配でね。サイフィールドが止まっていても、あそこには危険が多い。マークド・ワン、無理でなければ、もう一度X-16へ降りて様子を見てきてくれないか？ すでに行ったことがある君が適任だ。

entries.EN: I have no time right now. I don't think anything serious happened to them, I cleaned up the place well.
entries.JA_current: I have no time right now. I don't think anything serious happened to them, I cleaned up the place well.
entries.JA_new: 今は無理だ。大したことは起きてないと思う。あそこはきれいに片付けてきたからな。

entries.EN: Thank you, Marked One! Again, the expedition was comprised of Doctor Petrov, an assistant, and a security detail of three soldiers and a major as team leader. They won't attack you, don't be afraid, their goal is only to protect the professor.
entries.JA_current: Thank you, Marked One! Again, the expedition was comprised of Doctor Petrov, an assistant, and a security detail of three soldiers and a major as team leader. They won't attack you, don't be afraid, their goal is only to protect the professor.
entries.JA_new: ありがとう、マークド・ワン！ もう一度言うが、遠征隊はペトロフ博士と助手、護衛の兵士三人、それに隊長の少佐で構成されている。襲ってきたりはしないから、心配しなくていい。教授を守るのが任務だからね。
